future_contributions.gap: Generalizability of CNN-based frameworks to non-ZigBee wireless standards
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Modular CNN architecture with protocol-agnostic feature extraction layers
future_contributions.technical_approach: Design a CNN with interchangeable front-end modules for different wireless standards (e.g., WiFi, LoRa, BLE), using adaptive pooling and frequency-invariant filters to capture protocol-specific signatures while maintaining cross-protocol consistency
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enables deployment across diverse wireless standards with minimal retraining, addressing the protocol-specific limitation of existing methods
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Leverages existing CNN architectures (e.g., ResNet) with protocol-specific training data; requires hardware compatibility for multi-standard signal capture

future_contributions.gap: Robustness against adversarial attacks in RF fingerprinting
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Adversarial-aware CNN with dynamic frequency hopping
future_contributions.technical_approach: Integrate a CNN with a frequency-hopping module that dynamically shifts carrier frequencies during inference, combined with adversarial training using gradient masking to counteract spoofing attacks
future_contributions.expected_impact: Significantly improves spoofing resistance by disrupting adversarial signal patterns and reducing attack surface
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Requires hardware support for frequency hopping and software integration with CNN training pipelines; feasible with modern RF transceivers

future_contributions.gap: Integration of semi-supervised learning with real-time signal processing
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Lightweight semi-supervised CNN with temporal consistency constraints
future_contributions.technical_approach: Develop a pruned CNN with stochastic depth regularization and temporal consistency loss, enabling real-time inference using edge computing hardware while maintaining semi-supervised performance
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enables low-latency deployment in resource-constrained environments without sacrificing generalization
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Compatible with FPGA/ASIC accelerators; requires optimization of data augmentation strategies for real-time processing

future_contributions.gap: Unified framework for cross-protocol RF fingerprinting analysis
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Cross-protocol meta-architecture with standardized feature representation
future_contributions.technical_approach: Create a meta-architecture that maps signals from different protocols to a shared latent space using autoencoders, enabling cross-protocol comparison and benchmarking through standardized feature extraction
future_contributions.expected_impact: Facilitates comparative analysis and benchmarking across wireless standards, addressing methodological fragmentation
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Requires collaboration for multi-protocol dataset collection; leverages existing frameworks like PyTorch for modular implementation

future_contributions.gap: Diverse dataset collection for non-WiFi/non-ZigBee protocols
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Open-source multi-protocol RF dataset with standardized metadata
future_contributions.technical_approach: Establish a crowdsourced dataset collection protocol using open-source hardware (e.g., USRP, RTL-SDR) to capture signals from LoRa, BLE, and NB-IoT devices, with standardized metadata for signal characteristics and environmental conditions
future_contributions.expected_impact: Provides benchmark datasets for evaluating cross-protocol generalization and fairness in RF fingerprinting
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Feasible through community-driven data collection; requires metadata standardization and open-access storage solutions
